nesajjika.cp: adj. remaining in a sitting position.
nesajjika.p: [Nisajjā+ṇika.(nesajjia-prā)] (ti) CL=9 Person who practices sitting or sitting meditation; person who vows the practice of sitting and sitting meditation strictly
a: နေသဇ္ဇိက(တိ)
[နိသဇ္ဇာ+ဏိက။(နေသဇ္ဇိအ-ပြာ)]

nesajjika： nesajjika（ti）
နေသဇ္ဇိက（တိ）
[nisajjā+ṇika．（nesajjia-prā）]
[နိသဇ္ဇာ+ဏိက။ （နေသဇ္ဇိအ-ပြာ）]
C: nesajjika：[adj．] remaining in a sitting position．
P: Nesajjika，（adj．） [fr．nisajjā] being & remaining in a sitting position （as an ascetic practice） A．III，220； Th．1，904，1120； Nd2 587； J．IV，8； Pug．69； Vism．79； Miln．20，342．The n-°aṅga is one of the dhūtaṅga-precepts，enjoining the sitting posture also for sleeping，see Vin．V，193，Vism．61，& dhūtaṅga．（Page 378）
K:
nesajjika：နေသဇ္ဇိက（တိ）
[နိသဇ္ဇာ+ဏိက။ （နေသဇ္ဇိအ-ပြာ）]
ထိုင်နေခြင်း-အလေ့-ကျင့်ဝတ်-ရှိသော၊ နိသဇ်ဓုတင်-ဆောင်-ဆောက်-တည်-သော၊ သူ။
R:
nesajjika：နေသဇ္ဇိက （တိ） （နိသဇ္ဇာ+ဏိက）
ထိုင်ခြင်းလျှင် ကျင့်ဝတ် ရှိသည်။ ထိုင်ခြင်းဖြင့် သီတင်းသုံးလေ့ ရှိသည်။ နိသဇ်ဓုတင် ဆောက်တည်သည်။
DOP: nesajjika mfn. and m. [ BHS naiṣadyika], (an ascetic) who does not use a bed; (an ascetic or bhikkhu ) who rests or sleeps only in a sitting position; requiring sitting only (not lying); a bhikkhu who has undertaken the dhutaṅga (qv) of not lying down ; Vin V 131, 17 (pañca ~ā) ≠ A III 220, 3 ; M III 42, 5 (asappuriso ~o hoti); Th 904 (pañcapaññāsa vassāni yato ~o ahaṃ); Ja IV 8, 12 (paṇṇasālaṃ katvā rukkhamūliko ahosi abbhokāsiko ~o, sace nipajjitukāmo bhūmiyaṃ yeva nipajjati); Ap 19, 9 (keci ~ā isī; Ap-a 224, 1 : nisajjiriyāpathasampannā); Mil 20, 23 foll. (bhikkhū ~ā nūna te pubbe panthadūsakā corā … tassa kammassa nissandena etarahi ~ā bhavanti); Vism 78, 30 (tena pana ~ena rattiyā tīsu yāmesu ekaṃ yāmaṃ uṭṭhāya caṅkamitabbaṃ iriyāpathesu hi nipajjitum eva na vaṭṭati); 79, 21* (tasmā samanuyuñjeyya dhīro ~aṃ vataṃ); — °’- aṅga , n. [nesajjika + aṅga 2 ], the practice of resting only in a sitting position (not lying down; one of the 13 dhutaṅga s ) Nidd I 66, 24 ; Mil 359, 22 ; Vism 61, 20 (sayanaṃ paṭikkhipitvā nisajjāya viharituṃ sīlaṃ assā ti nesajjiko, tassa aṅgaṃ ~aṃ); 78, 28 foll. (seyyaṃ paṭikkhipāmi ~aṃ samādiyāmī ti).
NCP: gen. /dat. (an ascetic) who does not use a bed; (an ascetic or bhikkhu) who rests or sleeps only in a sitting position; requiring sitting only (not lying); a bhikkhu who has undertaken the dhutanga of not lying down.

NCP: mfn. & masculine a | nesaada man of a particular low caste (of hunters); a fowler, a hunter.
